name: Straight Bar Dip
steps: Take an overhand grip just outside shoulder width and come into straight-arm support above a secure horizontal bar at hip level.
Brace your core, lean your chest slightly forward over the bar, and keep your legs slightly in front of the bar for counterbalance.
Bend your elbows slowly behind you to lower your chest smoothly toward the bar until your upper arms reach roughly parallel.
Press forcefully downward through your palms to extend your arms back to the top support position.
tips: Lean your upper torso slightly ahead of the bar as you descend so you stay balanced over your hands.
Keep your shoulders pulled down away from your ears throughout the press.
